what: No durable handoff covers the boundary after /larch:issue runs but before decompose-file-issues.sh annotate writes .decompose-issues-filed
scenario_or_breakage: If /larch:issue creates some or all partition issues and the orchestrator dies before annotate, the next run sees no parent sentinel and can invoke /larch:issue again; dedup is not an unambiguous rerun contract, especially after partial dependency-write failures
suggested_fix: Pass an explicit --sentinel-file under $DESIGN_TMPDIR/decompose, capture stdout to a fixed file, and on rerun treat issue-sentinel or issue stdout as requiring annotate or operator halt rather than another /larch:issue invocation

what: .decompose-issues-filed conflates partial and complete filing states
scenario_or_breakage: Edge case 6 allows annotate to record partial state while edge case 7 says the same sentinel makes reruns skip refiling and proceed to close; a restart can skip failed pieces or close the original from incomplete partition-filed.md
suggested_fix: Only write .decompose-issues-filed for ISSUES_FAILED=0, write a distinct .decompose-issues-partial for partial runs, and make close-original verify every expected piece has a filed URL before posting or closing

what: Manual partial-recovery editing is not surfaced and the plan states the edit backward
scenario_or_breakage: The plan says rerun should complete only failed pieces but says the operator must remove failed-piece entries; removing failed entries would preserve already-filed entries and risk duplicates while still not filing the failed work
suggested_fix: Add a required visible breadcrumb or AskUserQuestion on partial failure that identifies the exact file to edit, instructs removing successfully filed entries or preferably generates a failed-only retry input automatically, and blocks close until recovery completes

what: No sentinel records selected partition plus cycle-check pass before /larch:issue invocation
scenario_or_breakage: If the orchestrator crashes after cycle-check success and before filing, a rerun can rerun panel selection and cycle checking, potentially re-prompting over an already validated partition
suggested_fix: Add .decompose-partition-selected and .decompose-cycle-ok sentinels keyed by a partition-file hash; reruns with matching sentinels should skip selection and cycle revalidation and continue at filing

what: No sentinel separates close-comment posted from original issue closed
scenario_or_breakage: close-original posts a comment and then closes the issue, writing .decompose-original-closed only after both; if the comment succeeds but gh issue close fails or the orchestrator dies, rerun posts the same close-comment again
suggested_fix: Add a .decompose-close-comment-posted sentinel containing comment identity or scan for an idempotency marker before posting; reruns should skip the comment when present and only retry gh issue close
